items.title: Review wrapper rejects valid findings payloads
items.priorAttempts: Bundled into the same closed/unmerged #3013 attempt as #2902 (not resolved independently).
items.reproductionEvidence: Traced task/executor.ts's finalizeSubprocessOutput -> normalizeCompleteData (only backfills `findings` when absent, does not reject an already-present `findings`) -> buildOutputValidator -> jtdToJsonSchema. JTD (RFC 8927) schemas are closed-by-default unless the declaring schema sets additionalProperties: true, so a caller-declared outputSchema for a review-type task that lists `review` but not `findings`/additionalProperties would reject a payload containing both — consistent with the reported symptom. Could not pin down the exact declaring schema/call site (AgentDefinition.output is caller-supplied, not a fixed built-in schema in this codebase) within this pass's effort budget.
items.rationale: Root-cause mechanism (JTD closed-by-default) is identified with reasonable confidence but the exact declaring schema was not conclusively located; per the explicit 'establish reproduction ... evidence before mutation' instruction, this does not yet meet the bar for a confident, narrowly-scoped fix. Documented the mechanism for a follow-up pass rather than guessing at the fix location.
